name: semico
description: Semico — smart irrigation platform for Algerian farms. Monorepo: React client, Express + Prisma server, shared domain contracts.

scripts.build: npm --workspace shared run typecheck && npm --workspace server run build && npm --workspace client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace shared run typecheck && npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace server run test && npm --workspace client run test
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
